title: D1 dump() SQL export (empty DB, exact quoting/escaping, restore round-trip) + raw({columnNames:true|false}) shapes + the documented 50 MB query-result limit
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/worker-api/d1-database/#dump (dump() takes no parameters and returns the entire database as a SQLite-compatible file in an ArrayBuffer)
https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/worker-api/prepared-statements/#raw (raw() returns an array of arrays without column names by default; raw({columnNames:true}) prepends one row of column names)

https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/blob/7545be644952d71d76b904b37ae71b10c0ba8cad/src/workerd/server/tests/d1/d1-export-test.js (golden dump vectors: PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=TRUE, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for quoted names, INSERT INTO "t" ("c",...) VALUES(...), ''/\n/\r/X'..'/NULL/9e999 escaping, sqlite_sequence handling)

https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/blob/7545be644952d71d76b904b37ae71b10c0ba8cad/src/workerd/server/d1/d1.js (dumpSql implementation: statement order, identifier/string escaping; skipped _cf_/sqlite_ tables)

https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/blob/7545be644952d71d76b904b37ae71b10c0ba8cad/src/cloudflare/internal/d1-api.ts (dump() POSTs /dump and returns response.arrayBuffer(); raw() maps columns+rows; a non-200 /dump response throws D1_DUMP_ERROR)

https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-10-30-query-result-size-limit/ (the 50 MB limit is enforced from 2026-11-04; exact error text: "D1 query result exceeded the maximum response size limit of 50 MB")
https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/observability/debug-d1/#error-list (the oversized-result entry under D1_ERROR types; d1-api adds the D1_ERROR: prefix)
vrt-sql/tests/dump_tests.rs (byte-for-byte match against the workerd golden vectors, empty dump, restore round-trip, 50 MB rejection)

steps.name: dump() of an empty database is just the leading pragma
setup: quoted, newline/CR, blob, NULL and infinite values
raw() default and columnNames:false agree; columnNames:true prepends names; duplicate columns and empty results
dump() is restorable SQL with exact escaping

json.createLine: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, s TEXT, r REAL, b BLOB, n);

steps.name: a result above 50 MB fails with the documented D1 error

json.message: D1_ERROR: D1 query result exceeded the maximum response size limit of 50 MB
